methods.label: Rotate horizontal and vertical offsets
methods.explanation:
Relative to \(C(1,1)\), \(P(4,3)\) is \(4-1=3\) units right and \(3-1=2\) units up. A \(90^\circ\) counterclockwise rotation turns a rightward step upward and an upward step leftward, preserving their lengths. Thus \(P'\) is \(2\) units left and \(3\) units up from \(C\), giving
\[
P'=(1-2,\,1+3)=(-1,4).
\]
methods.levelReason: Horizontal and vertical offsets, coordinate shifts, and quarter-turn geometry are accessible within Grade 9 and avoid introducing formal vectors.
